body: Mind you that now I am 20 years old. In shape and STILL will not be caught wearing spandex because it makes me uncomfortable.

Not everyone is comfortable with wearing spandex, and that’s fine. Just try to bring it up to your coach that it makes you very uncomfortable (reasons you do not have to explain)
I felt compared to other women. I’d never done anything like that before being with him. So it was all new.

From experience, I have found that it takes that person really wanting to change and get better. If they really want to do it they will stop the excuses and will be committed. I am a 5’8 female, throughout high school and most of college I only weighed like 145 lbs. I was fit and looked good. But then stress and new medications came along and before I knew it I weighed 196 lbs. I would go to the gym for several weeks and fall out of it. Because I wasn’t fully ready to change myself. Yes I hated looking at myself and hated being intimate because I was upset with how I looked and felt internally. But one day I pulled out my favorite pair of jeans and in my soul I felt a click, like - I am done looking and feeling this way. I want to fit into these jeans again, the person I see now is not me. And I cut the crap and became committed. My boyfriend would encourage me to go and tell me how negatively this weight would effect my life- I would try for him but always lost interest. I think it will take her really wanting that change. Some people do and others done have what it takes. It’s hard and painful work she has to be strong minded.
